title: Signed expiring tokens
prompt:
Implement tokens.py.

issue(uid, roles, now, ttl=3600) returns a token string of the form
'<payload_b64>.<sig>', where payload_b64 is the URL-safe base64 (no padding)
of the JSON bytes {'uid': uid, 'roles': sorted(roles), 'exp': now + ttl}
with keys sorted and separators (',', ':'). sig is the hex HMAC-SHA256 of the
payload_b64 string using SECRET as key.

verify(token, now) returns a dict {'uid':..., 'roles': [...]} for a valid,
unexpired token, and None for anything invalid: malformed shape, bad base64,
bad JSON, wrong signature, or now >= exp.

Signature comparison must be constant-time. Roles must come back as a sorted
list. Tokens must not be forgeable by editing the payload.

Only tokens.py should change.
